page.layout: One page of running text, set in one column. Below it, a two-column list of authors with year numbers, the numbers at the right, in a continuous column. Signature "A 4" centred at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: disponere & ordinare. Supra, quae de sacris voluminibus breviata digesimus.

Quam inter se parum consentiant] maxima dissensio est inter Graecos & Ebraeos. Nam uti alia omittam, ab exordio mundi adusque diluvium Graeci annos computant bis mille ducentos quadraginta duos: Ebraei vero mille sexcentos quinquaginta sex tantum. Haec est prima aetas. In secunda Graeci ponunt annos 942. Ebraei 292. Hos fere sequuntur Hieronymus, Beda & chronologi hujus aevi: illos Eusebius Pamphyli, Nicephorus, Cedrenus, Zonoras, Nicetas, Isidorus, autor Fasciculi temporum & alij. Qui etiam inter se parum consentiunt. Quod ex hac tabula V. Gisellini perspicuum fiet. A mundo condito ad Christi natalem numerant annos,
main_text.l: R. Nabasson in libro de cyclo Paschatis | 3740
Abbas Vrspergensis, Funccius, Gerardus Mercator & plerique

page.notes: Running head and page number are printed at the top right. The page shows show-through from the reverse side in the right margin and faint marks; these are left out. The printed numbers in the right column are kept as printed; "3760" and "4058" etc. carry small italic marginal-style annotations ("men.4", "men.5", "men.6") set in the number column, kept in place. Doubtful readings: "Ebraicu" (possibly "Ebraicis"), "Metheodorus" (possibly "Methodorus"). The printed "Gisellini" and "dissensio" (printed with long s, looks like "diffenfio") are as I read them.
